sloka: मन्ये प्राप्ता: स्म तं देशं भरद्वाजो यमब्रवीत्।नातिदूरे हि मन्येऽहं नदीं मन्दाकिनीमित: ॥ २.९९.९॥
transliteration: manye prāptā: sma taṁ deśaṁ bharadvājo yamabravīt।nātidūre hi manye'haṁ nadīṁ mandākinīmita: ॥ 2.99.9॥

translations.english: We must have reached the region about which Bharadwaja had spoken. I think river Mandakini is not far from here.
